scope: Actual production atlas probe poses, authored-tract containment and overlay invocation. No measured patient depth, clinical registration, collision certification, browser rendering or frame-rate claim.
checks: All 28 production poses are finite, orthonormal, electronically consistent and explicitly unregistered; source frames and authored anatomy remain unchanged.
All ten formerly hidden acquired probes remain in their intended modeled organ. Plane offset and angle disagreement are retained rather than silently projecting the probe through a wall.
Every retained tight geometric fit still lies in its original measured CT plane and satisfies the unchanged projection limits.

Descending-aortic pairs share a lower-esophageal, left/posterior-facing mechanical pose; arch pairs share an upper-esophageal, anterior-facing pose. Only the electronic plane changes within each pair.
Deep TG is advanced below the ordinary gastric estimates and faces superiorly; it remains explicitly independent of an ideal registered Doppler axis.
Compact framing support contains every vertex of the production transducer head and its nearby shaft, without forcing a close-up to include the entire proximal esophagus.

Actual atlas overlay sends all 28 probes to the shared-depth scene, uses amber dashed independent fans, and respects explicit probe/sector/context switches. Pose metadata is available before any canvas draw.
Both comparison donors produce finite geometric estimates from their own scale and frame without importing LADAF tissue landmarks.
